sections.text: The synthetic powertrain project contains TorqueCoordinator, PedalSensor and MotorController. The current reviewed teaching revision is 2.0.

Component: PedalSensor | input: RawPedal | output: PedalPosition | period_ms: 10
Component: TorqueCoordinator | input: PedalPosition | output: TorqueRequest | period_ms: 10
Component: MotorController | input: TorqueRequest | output: MotorCurrent | period_ms: 10

Signal: PedalPosition | producer: PedalSensor | consumer: TorqueCoordinator | unit: percent | min: 0 | max: 100
Signal: TorqueRequest | producer: TorqueCoordinator | consumer: MotorController | unit: Nm | min: 0 | max: 250
TorqueCoordinator uses a PedalPosition timeout of 50 ms. When a pedal signal is stale, TorqueRequest is set to zero and diagnostic event PEDAL_STALE is recorded.
During startup, TorqueCoordinator sets TorqueRequest to zero until a valid PedalPosition is available. MotorController initializes MotorCurrent to zero.

Interface: ITorque | sender: TorqueCoordinator | receiver: MotorController | sender_unit: Nm | receiver_unit: Nm
Interface: IPedal | sender: PedalSensor | receiver: TorqueCoordinator | sender_unit: percent | receiver_unit: percent

Dependency: TorqueCoordinator -> PedalSensor
Dependency: MotorController -> TorqueCoordinator
Revision 2.0 changes pedal timeout from 100 ms to 50 ms, maximum torque from 300 Nm to 250 Nm, and TorqueCoordinator period from 20 ms to 10 ms.
